locations.note: Comatose after a crash chasing the escaped Jericho, Tanner shifts between drivers in a dream San Francisco, then wakes to stop the prison breakout Jericho's bomb hoax was covering.
Tanner's dream city keeps the bridge as the road north out of San Francisco to the Marin headlands.
Across the Golden Gate, Marin's hill and coast roads are part of the world Tanner shifts through.
Tanner's dream city keeps the bridge as the road east across the bay to Oakland.
Across the Bay Bridge, Oakland's streets are part of the world Tanner shifts through.
In the Wii version's prequel story, Tanner and Jones chase Solomon Caine by police helicopter until his own helicopter crashes on the island.
